title: A wonderful experience
text:
Alhambra was fabulous 
The ride to Granada was smooth and it wasn’t long
The drivers were good and the tour guide was excellent.
author: Patrick_L

title: Nice
text: Driver was available infront of the cruise docking area. You just have to coordinate the meeting place. The guide/owner will text text you to make sure. Guide was very good too! All smooth as you can imagine with your family.
author: Mohammed_A

title: Tour of the Alhambra
text: We are travelling with friends by Ship and booked a trip from Motril cruise port to the Alhambra. From collection at the ship to the tour and return our experience was excellent. Both drivers and our tour guide Gosia could not have been better. The all inclusive price was very reasonable when compared with other tours we saw before booking. Recommended!
author: Alison M

title: Alhambra Tour
text: The Gardens and tile work in Alhambra were amazing to see.  And the amount of the Moorish influence that remained.
author: Charles_D
